sentence: This project provides data collection, monitoring, and statistical analysis for multicenter studies of women with pelvic floor disorders.
This project tries to find out what metabolic abnormalities occur early after aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage and investigates treatments that target metabolism.
This project builds a robotic screening platform that runs millions of nanoliter-scale chemical reactions in parallel to generate data for training AI models.
This project follows patients who received corneal transplants to find out whether diabetes in donors and recipients affects endothelial cell loss and graft success.
This project studies somatic mutations in endometriosis across a diverse group of patients, using single cell transcriptomics, exome-sequencing and a transplant model.
This project builds fluorescence microscopy tools that watch enzymatic activities in living cells as they move, attach, and invade.
This project uses computational methods to study how light-driven molecular nanomotors disrupt membranes and to improve their molecular structure for photopharmacology.
This project tries to find out how Schwann cell plasticity is controlled, in an effort to identify therapeutic targets for nerve injury.
This project builds a quantum-inspired framework that treats medical imaging data as dynamic mode systems to separate signal from noise and reconstruct images.
This project studies long-term memory changes in older cancer survivors in the US and England, looking at socioeconomic factors and risk factors for dementia.
This project tests whether aging weakens the recycling of extracellular mitochondria by immune cells and so worsens vascular cognitive impairment after stroke.
This project studies how genes linked to brain disorders work in neurons to promote brain growth.
This project builds a screening platform that uses worm, fly, fish, mouse, or human stem cell models to test genetic variants linked to birth defects.
This project studies the natural products made by human oral pathogens and oral probiotics, including their identity, how they are made, and their roles.
This project builds a technology platform to study how histone reader domains interact with post-translational modifications and how disease mutations change their function.
This project acquires a liquid handling system that automates next-gen sequencing workflows for biomedical research.
This project provides services for molecular phenotyping and genotyping, including DNA extraction, gene expression analysis, and single cell RNA-sequencing, to study mechanisms of disease.
This project studies why colorectal cancer resists small molecules that target an oncogene, and looks for new therapeutic combinations.
This project provides computational analysis of next generation sequencing data for cancer researchers, including single cell epigenomics, transcriptomics and genomics.
This project tests an imaging approach that measures artery calcium and muscle blood flow in patients with peripheral artery disease in one imaging session.
